title: The IDP slot beside Camunda is already taken, so this Camunda demo must lead with sovereign procurability
content:
The mechanical demo is the standard Camunda one: a job worker dispatches a typed operation at each user-task boundary, and then the process instance is deleted and the whole approval chain replayed from Powerhouse. That shows the record outliving the orchestrator that produced it.

The positioning constraint is what distinguishes this group. The research text notes that the intelligent-document-processing slot beside Camunda is already occupied by Camunda IDP plus ABBYY, so a pitch framed as "we complete Camunda" runs straight into the vendor's own product and its existing partner. The instruction is to lead with sovereign procurability instead — the argument that the record layer can be procured and operated under the client's own control, which is not what the incumbent pairing offers.

The cohort is ten leads, five in DE, four in NL and one in UK, with one at priority 1, one at priority 2, five at "3 · later" and three at "9 · do not pitch". Four of the ten arrived via the "Camunda cohort (unverified)" source, which means part of the group's Camunda relationship is itself unconfirmed and is tracked as a separate flag — the demo is ready before the qualification is.
